types.label: Nothing is building
types.description: No build is running while the Queue has work (with the reason: no free account, no Fable account, a split still to come), or the Queue is empty and builds wait in Pending for you. Pushed to the phone once per idle spell; cleared when a build runs.

types.label: FYI: build retry attempt
types.description: vps-never-gives-up: an FYI each time the server starts a new attempt on a failing build (crash, red CI, a clash, a failed push, a stall, a fall back to Pending): what broke, the strategy it tries now (retry, merge main, a fix, a fresh session, another model or account) and what is left before it is marked Failed. Nothing to do; one per attempt.

types.label: Build failed: every option used up
types.description: done-means-merged@1: a build failed (crash, red CI, a clash, a failed push, a stall, a fall back to Pending) and the server tried every rung of its retry ladder (the same approach, a fix, a fresh session, another model or account) without getting past it. One push per escalation with what broke, every try and since when; the build is on the systems check banner (Builds that need you) with Retry. Never pushed twice for the same escalation.

types.label: Dispatcher self-check
types.description: The dispatcher checked every Claude account one by one (signed in, limited, API key saved and not rejected, free slots) and either fixed something (released a slot held by an ended session, cleared an expired limit, put a build that never ran back in the Queue) or found an account it can't use, with what to do.

types.label: VPS reaper cleared ghosts
types.description: vps-reaper@1: the VPS killed processes nothing owns any more and says what and why: a claude -p still running after its build log ended (the run is closed and handed to the lander), a dead tmux axf-* session, an agent slot or heavy lock held by a host or process that is gone, a test server left on a port. A build that is working is never touched. One FYI per pass; every kill is also a note on AmberX's Automatic fixes list.

types.label: Build started
types.description: The dispatcher started a headless session for a Queue build: which account, which model, which phase.

types.label: Build ended, returned or failed
types.description: A dispatcher session ended: every step done (built), crashed and back in the Queue, stopped early and back in Pending for you, or failed after too many runs.

types.label: Queued build failed to start
types.description: The dispatcher picked a Queue build and it did not start: the build name and the exact reason from every account it tried (a refused login, no slot, the dispatch gate, a launcher error). Sent at once, for every failed start.

types.label: Build stopped on a Claude login failure
types.description: A build's run stopped on an OAuth / sign-in failure: which account, which build, the exact error. The build is held in Pending and goes back to the Queue by itself, once, when the account's health check signs in again (a second alert says so).

types.label: Build split into steps
types.description: The orchestrator split a new build into steps (or had to fall back to rules and asks you to review them).

types.label: Build FYI
types.description: A running build tells you about a milestone you asked to hear about (a fix queued, a branch landed, a migration done). Information only, nothing to act on.

types.label: Watchdog cleaned stale rows
types.description: FYI, one per run that cleaned something: how many stale rows the VPS watchdog took off the builds lists (Pending, Queue, Building, merge queue, UI Review) and which, each with why (PR merged, PR closed, build archived). Nothing to do; the Cleanups log has every one.
